text:
Bradley Barcola scored a hat-trick at LASK — his first goals for Liverpool, and the first of his senior career in his 206th game. Liverpool won 6-3 after leading 3-0 at half-time. Is he finally worth the £123m? 👇
#Barcola #Liverpool #ChampionsLeague #LASKLiverpool #Football
titulo: Barcola hat-trick: first Liverpool goals in a 6-3 win
